title: Weakly etale morphism of schemes
statement: A morphism of schemes $f:X\to Y$ is *weakly étale* (or *absolutely flat*) if $f$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and its diagonal morphism $\Delta_f:X\to X\times_YX$ into the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] is flat.
